notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where turrets were not returning to their proper state after being engaged or stunned
- small bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
- player respawn speed increased 30%
- player X velocity increased when wall jumping
- player will no longer hit adjacent wall-hazards when climbing along one wall
- player will no longer get infinitely stuck on a conveyor in some situations 
- fixed turret issues during/after stun
- removed the ability to gain a flappy jump from conveyors
- fixed an issue that could result in players immediately being sent back through a purple portal after entering one
- fullscreen button can now be clicked on with a mouse
- added a windows title bar to the game window
